page.overview:
Who is God Broly?

In this form, Broly has a massive resemblance to his Legendary Super Saiyan and Legendary Super Saiyan 3 forms, possessing the latter's hair length and greener tint and former's eyebrows. He also has three prominent front bangs, the longer two curving downward on either side of his face. Like his Legendary Super Saiyan forms, his size and appearance do not affect his speed. His aura in this form appears similar to a green-tinted Super Saiyan-like aura.

In this form, thanks to being able to possess the powers of a deity like him, Broly is strong enough to easily defeat Super Saiyan Blue Goku. He is described as an enemy Goku can do nothing against, and in the preview, he is shown easily beating base Goku. In the form itself, God Broly is strong enough to fight Goku in his Super Saiyan Blue form and base Vegeta at the same time, and at one point knocking Super Saiyan Blue Vegeta out when he was forced to get in the way of a blast to protect Bulma. However, though God Broly is briefly able to hold his own in a fistfight against God Fusion Goku, he is annihilated while charging up his attack with a single Kamehameha.

God Broly appeared as a non-playable form for Broly in Super Dragon Ball Heroes, where he was fought in two battles in a challenge mission that was available in August 2017. God Broly in both battles took extra damage from Kamehameha Super Attacks.
